eyebrow: Azure NC A100 v4 GPU VM
code:
resource "azurerm_linux_virtual_machine" "gpu_train" {
  name                = "gpu-train-01"
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.ml.name
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.ml.location
  size                = "Standard_NC24ads_A100_v4"
  admin_username      = "mladmin"

  network_interface_ids = [azurerm_network_interface.gpu.id]

  source_image_reference {
    publisher = "microsoft-dsvm"
    offer     = "ubuntu-hpc"
    sku       = "2204"
    version   = "latest"
  }
}
caption: Same azurerm_linux_virtual_machine resource — size is what makes it a GPU VM.
p4d.24xlarge: 8x NVIDIA A100 with NVLink — AWS's mainstream multi-GPU trainer.
